senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. preced.) to shrink; to feel aversion, loathe, fear &c.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 863:4">Yalk. Deut. 863</cite> <he>אל תָּקוּצוּ בדברי וכ׳</he> be not wearied of studying the words of the Law, but let the last day be like the first. Sifra K’dosh., Par. 4, ch. XI (ref. to <he>ואקץ</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 20:23">Lev. XX, 23</cite>) <he>כאדם שהוא קָץ ממזונו</he> like a man that is sick of his food (and vomits; Yalks. Lev. 626 <he>קָמֵט במזונו</he>).
<cite ref="Megillah 28a:15">Meg. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>קַצְתָּ בחיי</he> art thou wearied of my long life?; a. e.
